name: claudetto
description: Trims Claude Code 2.1.329 to what beats vanilla: disables the bundled builtin plugins at load, hands over context at task boundaries, and keeps prompt caching warm.

protectedPaths.title: Walled-off paths
protectedPaths.description: Folders no session may read or write: setup adds a Read deny rule and sandbox denyRead and denyWrite for each. Default: the held-out eval set.

memoryFreeMinPercent.title: Free memory share that holds new work
memoryFreeMinPercent.description: Below this share of free memory, a new command or subagent is refused until runs end. 0 turns it off.

bashTimeLimitMinutes.title: Time limit for a shell command
bashTimeLimitMinutes.description: A shell command still running after this many minutes is stopped with its child processes, also when it runs in the background. 0 turns it off.

includeGitInstructions.title: claudetto's git instructions
includeGitInstructions.description: Adds a short git block with the attribution lines from settings to the Bash tool, in place of Claude Code's own, which setup turns off with includeGitInstructions false. Turned off here, set includeGitInstructions to true in settings to get the builtin block back.
